title: Your first trade for Thursday, December 6
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Pete Najarian was a buyer of Merck .
Tim Seymour was a buyer of Boeing .
Dan Nathan was a buyer of Disney .
Guy Adami was a buyer of Twitter .
